info.name: WebCuoi API
info.description: Full API collection for the WebCuoi wedding invitation server. Select the WebCuoi Local environment, start the Node.js server, and configure adminApiKey for admin requests.

request.description: Checks that the API process and MongoDB connection are ready.
Returns the public invitation document, including couple, event locations, gallery, dress code, schedule, gift accounts, and theme.
Creates a complete invitation document. Change slug before sending if that slug already exists. Requires ADMIN_API_KEY as a Bearer token.
Updates the venue fields used by the map endpoint. Add a Google Place ID or latitude/longitude for more exact map targeting. Requires ADMIN_API_KEY as a Bearer token.
Returns venue data plus maps.searchUrl, maps.directionsUrl, and maps.embedUrl when GOOGLE_MAPS_EMBED_API_KEY is configured. The directions link opens Google Maps on desktop and mobile.
Returns the ceremony venue map links.
Stores an attending response and attempts to email the RSVP notification address configured on the server. This request creates a database record.

body.raw:
{
  "guestName": "Nguyễn Bình",

  "attendance": "not-attending",
  "guestCount": 0,
  "note": "Rất tiếc, mình không thể đến."
}

request.description: Stores a decline response and attempts to email the RSVP notification address configured on the server. This request creates a database record.
Returns all RSVP entries for this invitation. Requires ADMIN_API_KEY as a Bearer token.
Lists guestbook entries newest first. page starts at 1; limit is capped at 50.
Adds a guestbook message. This request creates a database record.
